# Android Prado ironSource Adapter

## Requirements
- Android API level 21 or higher
- Prado Android SDK 11.x
- ironSource LevelPlay SDK (`com.unity3d.ads-mediation:mediation-sdk`) 9.4.2 or higher

Check out the [ironSource Integration Documentation](https://developers.is.com/ironsource-mobile/android/android-sdk/) for app level integration.
## Integration Steps:

Include the following inside your app build.gradle dependencies:

```java
dependencies {
    implementation("co.prado.sdk:prado-android-ironsource-adapter:{{VERSION}}")
}
```
